description: Multi-phase conversion rate optimization audit for marketing pages: value proposition, CTA analysis, trust signals, friction assessment, and A/B experiment design

required.name: page_urls
required.description: URLs of the pages to audit for conversion optimization

required.name: conversion_goals
required.description: Primary conversion goals for the pages (e.g., form submissions, purchases, signups)

required.name: page_type
required.description: Type of page being audited (e.g., landing page, product page, pricing page)

optional.name: traffic_sources
optional.description: Primary traffic sources driving visitors to the pages

optional.name: current_conversion_rate
optional.description: Current conversion rate baseline for benchmarking

optional.name: heatmap_data
optional.description: Heatmap or click-tracking data for user behavior analysis

optional.name: session_recordings
optional.description: Session recording tool access for user journey analysis

optional.name: existing_ab_tests
optional.description: Currently running or past A/B test results

optional.name: analytics_access
optional.description: Analytics platform access details for data-driven recommendations

optional.name: competitor_urls
optional.description: Competitor page URLs for comparative analysis
